question: The 42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment was made according to the recommendation of ________, set up in 1976.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh Committee.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Constitutional Amendment Act** was passed in **1976** during the emergency period in India.
 
• The amendment brought about significant changes in the** Constitution**, including the **insertion of Fundamental Duties**, the transfer of certain subjects from **State List to Concurrent List,** and the expansion of the scope of the** Directive Principles of State Policy.**
 
• The **Swaran Singh Committee** was set up in** 1975** to review the working of the Constitution and suggest amendments.
 
• It submitted its report in **1976,** which formed the basis of the **42nd Amendment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhijeet Sen Committee:**

 
 
• This committee was set up in** 2004** to review the functioning of the** Small Scale Industries sector** and suggest measures for its growth and development. 
 
 
 
• **Ajit Kumar Committee**:
 
 
• This committee was set up in** 2013** to review the functioning of the **Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)** and suggest measures for its improvement.
 
 
 
• **Abid Hussain Committee:**
 
 
• This committee was set up in **1994 **to review the functioning of the** World Trade Organization (WTO) **and suggest measures for the participation of developing countries in the global trade regime.
